say:1:1422918001:0.text: Okay, okay, I get it! I'm sorry! Please, spare me!
say:1:1422918001:0.source_cn: 我错了！我错了！您大人有大量，别打了！
say:1:1422918001:0.male: Okay, okay, I get it! I'm sorry! Please, spare me!
say:1:1422918001:0.female: Okay, okay, I get it! I'm sorry! Please, spare me!

say:2:1422918002:0.text: What happened to all that tough talk? We've still got a few things to settle. So? Why scam me?
say:2:1422918002:0.source_cn: 现在怎么没有刚刚的气势了？我们要跟你算的账还多着呢！说...

say:3:1422918003:1.text: I just got a little greedy, alright?!

say:4:1422918004:1.text: Before the royal city mess, I was working in the mines. After everything that happened, I had nowhere to go, so I started looking for ways to make some money.
say:4:1422918004:1.source_cn: 王城出事以前，我一直在地底干活，后来上头出了事……我没...

say:5:1422918005:1.text: Then one day, I overheard some fishermen talking about the Fish King. I figured, why not set up a spot here and tell that reporter I saw it? Thought I could make some cash that way...
say:5:1422918005:1.source_cn: 有一天，我无意间听见几个钓鱼佬在聊鱼王的传说。我就想了...

say:6:1422918006:0.text: So it was all a lie? You've never even seen the Fish King!
say:6:1422918006:0.source_cn: 原来这些全都是你编的！你见都没见过鱼王，却假装成资深钓...

say:7:1422918007:1.text: And that whole "buying the Fish King for ten thousand gold" thing—was that a lie, too?
say:7:1422918007:1.source_cn: 那你说你要用一万金币收购鱼王，也是……

say:8:1422918008:1.text: Yes. Anyone who wasn't even interested in the Fish King would jump at the money. Sadly, that trick didn't work on you.
say:8:1422918008:1.source_cn: 我这么一说，那些原本对鱼王不感兴趣的人，都会为了钱想要...

say:9:1422918009:1.text: Quite the show, huh? You really outdid yourself. And that's not all...
say:9:1422918009:1.source_cn: 好精彩的一出自导自演。而且不光这样……

choice_prompt:10:1422918009.text: Quite the show, huh? You really outdid yourself. And that's not all...
choice_prompt:10:1422918009.source_cn: 好精彩的一出自导自演。而且不光这样……

say:11:1422918010:1.text: Haha... These are all classic tricks. I didn't think anyone would actually fall for it though!
say:11:1422918010:1.source_cn: 哈哈……都是些常见的江湖伎俩，我也没想到真的会有人上当啊！

say:13:1422918012:0.text: Please, kind and merciful lady! I was wrong. Please just let me go!
say:13:1422918012:0.source_cn: 尊贵的、仁慈的、美丽的小姐，我错了，求求你放过我吧！

say:14:1422918013:0.text: Ha, don't think you're getting off that easy! I'm not letting you scam anyone else!
say:14:1422918013:0.source_cn: 哼，你想的美！我绝对不会把你放跑，让你再去骗其他钓鱼爱好者！

narration:15:1422918014:0.text: Duram returns the money he tricked Adelina out of, groveling for forgiveness.
narration:15:1422918014:0.source_cn: 杜兰姆把骗阿黛琳的钱还了回来，不停向你们求饶。

narration:17:1422918015:0.text: Adelina calls the guards, and they escort Duram and his thugs away...
narration:17:1422918015:0.source_cn: 阿黛琳还是叫来了卫兵，把杜兰姆一行押送走了……

choice:10:1:2.source_cn: 还有掺了滑鳞粉的高价鱼饵

choice:10:2:3.source_cn: 还借承包钓场的名义驱赶钓客
